source_row.rationale: Heart failure telemonitoring supports earlier detection of clinical worsening between office visits by tracking trends in weight and symptoms, potentially allowing timely intervention (such as medication adjustment) to help prevent hospitalization.
source_row.source_detail: Purpose and Potential Benefits of Telemonitoring
source_row.stem: A client with heart failure participates in a remote telemonitoring program, transmitting daily weight and symptom data to their care team. This technology supports:
